title: Hong Scanner event delivery record (VS-3)
description: Operational delivery record for one (event, device) push lifecycle (docs/REPLAY_CONTRACT.md section 13). This record is mutable operational state, separate from the immutable event fact: it is rewritten as attempts progress, while the fact it references never changes. It is never embedded in, merged with, or linked back into the event record.

attempts.description: Number of delivery attempts made for this (event_id, device_id) pair. 0 while the record is PENDING and nothing has been sent yet.

device_id.description: Stable identifier of the target device as issued by the scanner's own device registry. Never an FCM or other provider token itself: provider tokens are credentials, they live only in the platform's native storage, and they never enter any record, artifact, or the repository.

error_code.description: Provider error code of the last failed attempt, recorded verbatim; the set is open and fail-closed (unknown codes are kept as received, never mapped onto success). Documented examples: UNREGISTERED, SENDER_ID_MISMATCH, QUOTA_EXCEEDED. Present only after a FAILED attempt.

event_id.description: The event fact this delivery concerns; byte-equal to the fact's event_id (64 lowercase hex digits).

provider_message_id.description: Provider-assigned message id of the accepted attempt, recorded verbatim. Present only after an ACCEPTED attempt.

state.description: Delivery lifecycle state of this (event_id, device_id) pair. This is the only place delivery state exists; it must never appear in the event fact.

updated_at.description: When this delivery state was last rewritten, in the scanner canonical timestamp form YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM (see hs/sub_input.validIso8601Offset).

x-separation-rule: Operational record only: no importance or trust fields (severity, data_quality, direction, rank are fact fields), no verification state (the session-level verify output), no judgment fields. Delivery state never appears in the event fact; delivery can be retried, reordered or dropped without changing a single fact byte.
